ModMetaData.name: Right-Click Gizmo Indicator
ModMetaData.author: CheaterEater
ModMetaData.description:
Adds a small folded-corner marker to command buttons (gizmos) that have a right-click menu, so hidden right-click options are discoverable at a glance.
Works for vanilla and other mods' gizmos automatically — no configuration or load-order setup required. The marker appears on exactly the buttons whose right-click opens a float menu, using the same check the game itself uses.
Detection is computed once per button and cached, so there is no per-frame cost.
Requires Harmony.
